syntactic_simplification: Mice are important in neuroscience research. They provide a flexible model for scientists. Researchers can control and study mice to understand the brain. Historically, researchers preferred male mice for experiments. They had concerns about female hormone cycles. These cycles can cause behavioral variation. This variation could affect results.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain studies. They provide a useful model for scientists. Researchers can control and study mice to understand the brain. In the past, researchers preferred male mice for tests. They worried about female hormone cycles. These cycles can change behavior. This change could impact results.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important in studying the brain. They are useful for scientists to experiment with. Researchers can manage and observe mice to learn more about brain function. In the past, researchers mostly used male mice in tests. They were concerned that female hormone cycles, which change over time, could affect behavior. These changes might influence the results of the experiments.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important in studying the brain. They are useful for experiments. Researchers can manage and observe mice to learn about brain function. In the past, they mostly used male mice. They worried that female hormone cycles could affect behavior and influence results.
